# ViT-Base/16

Classification · `vit-b-p16_224x224` · DX-APP C++ example

Classification model, evaluated on ILSVRC2012.

**Input** 224 × 224 × 3 · **Dataset** ILSVRC2012 · **License** Apache-2.0 · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro, Q-Master

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](../../../../python_example/image_classification/vit/vit-b-p16_224x224/model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models ViTBaseP16-2
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target vit-b-p16_224x224_sync   # once
./bin/vit-b-p16_224x224_sync \
  -m assets/models/vit-b-p16_224x224.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/image_classification/vit/vit-b-p16_224x224/vit-b-p16_224x224_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/vit-b-p16_224x224.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | Top1 |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 81.32 |
| Q-Lite | 79.87 (−1.45) |
| Q-Pro | 76.98 (−4.34) |
| Q-Master | 81.35 (+0.03) |

ILSVRC2012 · difference vs Raw in brackets.
